StrictRule: After each architecture review gate, if direction or proof is weak, a corrective subbundle must be created, completed, and revalidated before downstream work continues.
Notes: Do not accept the prior closure claim without fresh proof from the live repository.
Treat true canonicality, DB integrity, lifecycle invariants, and durable side-effect dispatch as the remaining red blockers.
Do not call the work complete while the schema still permits domain states the services merely assume away.
Do not claim test closure without `.trx` artifacts that actually show the relevant suites executed.
